title: Can Machines Help Us Answering Question 16 in Datasheets, and In Turn Reflecting on Inappropriate Content?
reasoning: The paper leverages the Socio-Moral Image Database (SMID) and socio-moral values to steer pre-trained models (CLIP) to detect inappropriate content. It explicitly addresses moral norms and the human sense of 'right' and 'wrong' as a mechanism for ethical dataset documentation.
